Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that the GET /api/employe endpoint returns a list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains a list of employee objects
Expected Result: Response status 200 with a JSON array of employee objects

Title: Get employee by valid ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns the employee details when a valid ID is provided
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/1
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the employee details with ID 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 with employee details for ID 1

Title: Get employee by non-existing ID
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe/{id} returns an empty employee object when the ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /api/employe/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains an empty employee object (default values)
Expected Result: Response status 200 with an empty employee object

Title: Create a new employee successfully
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee creates a new employee when valid data is provided
Pre-Conditions: No employee with the same ID exists
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with valid employee data in the body
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 201 Created
Verify the employee is saved in the repository
Expected Result: Employee is saved successfully; response status 200 or 201

Title: Update existing employee successfully
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates the employee details when a valid ID and data are provided
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with updated employee data in the body
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the response body contains the updated employee details
Verify the employee data is updated in the repository
Expected Result: Response status 200 with updated employee details

Title: Update non-existing employee returns 404
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} returns 404 Not Found when the employee ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/9999 with employee data in the body
Verify the response status code is 404 Not Found

Title: Delete existing employee successfully
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} deletes the employee when a valid ID is provided
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/1
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify the employee is removed from the repository
Expected Result: Employee is deleted successfully; response status 200 or 204

Title: Delete non-existing employee does not fail
Description: Verify that DELETE /api/employee/{id} does not fail when the employee ID does not exist
Test Steps: Send a DELETE request to /api/employee/9999
Verify the response status code is 200 OK or 204 No Content
Verify no error is returned
Expected Result: Response status 200 or 204 with no error

Title: Create employee with missing required fields
Description: Verify that POST /api/employee handles missing required fields gracefully
Test Steps: Send a POST request to /api/employee with an empty or incomplete employee object
Verify the response status code is 200 OK (as per current implementation no validation)
Verify the employee is saved with default or null values
Expected Result: Employee saved with null/default fields; response status 200

Title: Update employee with partial fields
Description: Verify that PUT /api/employee/{id} updates only provided fields and retains others
Pre-Conditions: An employee with ID 1 exists with full details
Test Steps: Send a PUT request to /api/employee/1 with partial employee data (e.g., only name)
Verify the response status code is 200 OK
Verify the updated employee has the new name and other fields remain unchanged
Expected Result: Response status 200 with updated name and unchanged other fields
